learning_path:
**Learning Path for Full-Stack Web Development with Python and JavaScript**

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | COU2543 | Fullstack Web Development | Coursera | Introduces full-stack web development concepts and sets the stage for the learner's journey. |
| 2 | EDX2871 | CS50's Web Programming with Python and JavaScript | edX | Builds on the foundational concepts from the first course, providing a comprehensive introduction to web programming with Python and JavaScript. |
| 3 | COU2112 | The Full Stack | Coursera | Expands on the web development concepts from the previous courses, focusing on the full-stack approach and Django framework. |
| 4 | EDX3074 | Guided Project: Build your first Node.js app | edX | Introduces the learner to Node.js and server-side development, building on the web development concepts from the previous courses. |
| 5 | COU6214 | IBM Full-Stack JavaScript Developer Professional Certificate | Coursera | Provides a comprehensive introduction to full-stack JavaScript development, including front-end and back-end development. |
| 6 | EDX2309 | Back-end Application Development with Node.js and Express | edX | Focuses on back-end development with Node.js and Express, building on the full-stack JavaScript concepts from the previous course. |
| 7 | COU3072 | Introduction to Web Development with HTML, CSS, JavaScript | Coursera | Introduces the learner to web development with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, providing a solid foundation for the learner's final project. |
| 8 | EDX2460 | Programming for Everybody (Getting Started with Python) | edX | Provides a comprehensive introduction to Python programming, building on the web development concepts from the previous courses. |
| 9 | COU3063 | Front-End Developer Capstone | Coursera | Focuses on front-end development, providing a comprehensive introduction to the skills and concepts necessary for a front-end developer. |
| 10 | EDX1534 | Full Stack Application Development Project | edX | Guides the learner through a full-stack application development project, applying the concepts and skills learned throughout the learning path. |

**Path Explanation**

This learning path covers the full-stack web development with Python and JavaScript, starting with foundational concepts and progressing to advanced topics. The path includes a mix of introductory, intermediate, and advanced courses, with regular check-ins and assessments to ensure the learner is retaining key concepts and building on previous knowledge. The path emphasizes problem-solving and critical thinking, with opportunities to apply theoretical concepts to real-world scenarios and projects. The final project guides the learner through a full-stack application development project, applying the concepts and skills learned throughout the learning path.

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | COU858 | Fundamentals of Accounting Specialization | Coursera | Foundational knowledge of accounting concepts |
| 2 | EDX469 | Financial Accounting Professional Certificate Examination | edX | Builds on foundational knowledge with a comprehensive understanding of financial accounting |
| 3 | COU3919 | Introduction to Financial Accounting: The Accounting Cycle Specialization | Coursera | Practical applications of financial accounting concepts |
| 4 | EDX3274 | Accounting | edX | Analyzing financial statements and understanding the accounting cycle |
| 5 | COU839 | Formal Financial Accounting | Coursera | Advanced financial accounting concepts, including financial reporting and accounting terminology |
| 6 | EDX1465 | Financial Accounting Fundamentals | edX | Practical application of financial accounting concepts to real-world scenarios |
| 7 | COU759 | Introduction to Financial Accounting | Coursera | Understanding financial statements, including the income statement, balance sheet, and statement of cash flows |
| 8 | EDX448 | Financial Accounting | edX | Advanced financial accounting concepts, including financial statement analysis and interpretation |
| 9 | COU6486 | Think like a CFO Specialization | Coursera | Strategic thinking and decision-making in financial accounting |
| 10 | EDX49 | Intermediate Bookkeeping | edX | Advanced bookkeeping concepts, including financial statement analysis and preparation |

**Path Explanation**

This learning path starts with foundational knowledge of accounting concepts in Period 1, building on that with a comprehensive understanding of financial accounting in Period 2. The path then progresses to practical applications of financial accounting concepts in Period 3, followed by advanced financial accounting concepts in Period 4. In Period 5, the learner will understand financial statements, including the income statement, balance sheet, and statement of cash flows. Period 6 will cover advanced financial accounting concepts, including financial statement analysis and interpretation. Period 7 will focus on strategic thinking and decision-making in financial accounting. Finally, in Period 8, the learner will apply advanced bookkeeping concepts, including financial statement analysis and preparation.

Note: The available courses do not fully cover the learner's request, as they do not include a course specifically on reading a company's annual report. However, the recommended courses provide a comprehensive understanding of financial accounting concepts, which will enable the learner to read and analyze a company's annual report.
expanded_query: I want to learn financial accounting well enough to read a company's annual report, which typically requires a prerequisite level of intermediate to advanced accounting knowledge and can be achieved within a duration of 3-6 months with consistent effort.

**Learning Path for Supply Chain and Operations Management**

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | EDX2327 | Operations Management | edx | Foundational knowledge of operations management |
| 2 | EDX210 | Supply Chain Comprehensive Exam | edx | Comprehensive understanding of supply chain management |
| 3 | EDX3338 | Operations Management | edx | In-depth knowledge of operations management and lean manufacturing |
| 4 | EDX2883 | Supply Chain Planning and Strategy | edx | Advanced understanding of supply chain planning and strategy |
| 5 | EDX1563 | Procurement and Logistics Management | edx | Practical skills in procurement and logistics management |
| 6 | EDX1505 | Supply Chains for Manufacturing: Inventory Analytics | edx | Advanced analytics for supply chain management |
| 7 | EDX1087 | Purchase management | edx | Understanding of purchase management and demand management |
| 8 | EDX3219 | Supply Chain Management | edx | Comprehensive understanding of supply chain management |
| 9 | EDX1089 | Supply Chain Management Tools and Techniques | edx | Practical skills in supply chain management tools and techniques |
| 10 | EDX901 | Supply Chain Design | edx | Advanced understanding of supply chain design |

The learning path starts with foundational knowledge of operations management (EDX2327) and supply chain management (EDX210). The next period builds on this knowledge with a comprehensive understanding of operations management and lean manufacturing (EDX3338). The following period advances to supply chain planning and strategy (EDX2883) and procurement and logistics management (EDX1563). The next period focuses on inventory analytics (EDX1505) and purchase management (EDX1087). The following period covers supply chain management (EDX3219) and supply chain management tools and techniques (EDX1089). The final period provides advanced understanding of supply chain design (EDX901).

This learning path covers the full duration of 10 periods, with at least one course per period. The courses are drawn from the list above, in a sensible order, progressing from foundational to advanced.

This learning path is designed to provide a comprehensive understanding of public health and epidemiology basics for a non-clinician learner. The path starts with foundational knowledge of public health concepts (EDX1337), followed by an introduction to One Health and its applications (EDX2188). The next step is understanding the role of lifestyle medicine in population health (EDX1590), which is essential for developing critical thinking and analytical skills in data analysis (EDX2607). The path then moves on to understanding the economic principles governing healthcare systems (EDX3370) and developing data literacy skills for effective decision-making (EDX140). Practical skills in data analysis and visualization using Excel (EDX2149) are also covered, followed by applying data science techniques to real-world problems (EDX1024) and integrating data engineering and analytics skills for a comprehensive understanding (EDX2259). The path concludes with developing programming skills for data science applications (EDX267), leadership skills in healthcare settings (EDX3402), and advanced data analysis skills using R (EDX685).

The path then covers stress management, abnormal psychology, and international psychiatry, before moving on to professional skills and project management. The path is designed to be flexible, allowing the learner to review and reflect on their understanding before moving on to the next course.

learning_path:
**Learning Path for Photography and Visual Design**

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | EDX3333 | Digital Photography | edx | Foundational course in photography, covering key concepts such as aperture, shutter speed, and ISO. |
| 2 | EDX3365 | Graphic Design | edx | Builds on the photography course, introducing visual design principles and techniques for creating effective designs. |
| 3 | EDX2165 | Designing and Developing an Online Course | edx | Applies design principles to online course development, focusing on instructional design and user experience. |
| 4 | EDX2546 | Design Thinking: Prototyping and User Testing | edx | Introduces design thinking and prototyping, allowing learners to develop and test their own design solutions. |
| 5 | EDX2044 | UX Prototyping | edx | Focuses on user experience (UX) prototyping, teaching learners how to create effective UX designs and test them with users. |
| 6 | EDX3278 | Instructional Design | edx | Applies design thinking and UX principles to instructional design, helping learners create effective learning experiences. |
| 7 | EDX322 | Teaching Critical Thinking through Art with the National Gallery of Art | edx | Encourages learners to think critically and creatively, using art to facilitate meaningful conversations and learning. |
| 8 | EDX221 | Design in the Classroom with Cooper Hewitt, Smithsonian Design Museum | edx | Provides practical strategies for teaching design in the classroom, using design thinking and problem-solving techniques. |
| 9 | EDX3378 | User Experience Design | edx | Focuses on user experience design, teaching learners how to create effective UX designs and test them with users. |
| 10 | EDX425 | Instructional Design Models | edx | Introduces various instructional design models, such as ADDIE, Dick and Carey, and Understanding by Design (UbD), and their implications for instructional design. |
| 11 | EDX1479 | How to Code: Simple Data | edx | Introduces programming concepts and data structures, preparing learners for more advanced coding and data analysis. |
| 12 | EDX1858 | Diseño de Juegos Educativos | edx | Applies design thinking and UX principles to educational game design, helping learners create effective and engaging learning experiences. |
| 13 | EDX1891 | Instructional Design and Technology: Learning Theories | edx | Introduces various learning theories, such as behaviorism, cognitivism, constructivism, and connectivism, and their implications for instructional design. |
| 14 | EDX688 | Guided Project: Web Development w/ HTML & CSS for Beginners | edx | Focuses on web development, teaching learners how to create effective web designs and test them with users. |
| 15 | EDX2163 | Arabic for non-Arabic Speakers | edx | Encourages learners to think critically and creatively, using Arabic language and culture to facilitate meaningful conversations and learning. |
| 16 | EDX2413 | Introduction to Object-Oriented Programming with Java II: Object-Oriented Programming and Algorithms | edx | Introduces object-oriented programming (OOP) concepts and algorithms, preparing learners for more advanced programming and data analysis. |
| 17 | EDX2199 | Introduction to Object-Oriented Programming with Java III: Exceptions, Data Structures, Recursion, and GUIs | edx | Focuses on OOP concepts and algorithms, teaching learners how to create effective OOP designs and test them with users. |
| 18 | EDX2911 | Preparing for the AP* Computer Science A Exam — Part 1 | edx | Introduces programming concepts and data structures, preparing learners for more advanced coding and data analysis. |
| 19 | EDX1339 | CS50's Introduction to Computer Science | edx | Focuses on computer science and programming, teaching learners how to create effective programs and test them with users. |
| 20 | EDX2309 | Back-end Application Development with Node.js and Express | edx | Applies design thinking and UX principles to back-end application development, helping learners create effective and engaging learning experiences. |

**How the path fits together**

This learning path for photography and visual design starts with foundational courses in photography and graphic design, building on the basics to introduce more advanced concepts in design thinking, UX, and instructional design. The path encourages learners to think critically and creatively, using art and design to facilitate meaningful conversations and learning. Throughout the path, learners will develop transferable skills in design thinking, UX, and programming, preparing them for more advanced learning and real-world applications.

**Learning Path for Cybersecurity, Network Defense, and Ethical Hacking**

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | COU3345 | The Complete Ethical Hacking Bootcamp: Beginner To Advanced Specialization | Coursera | Foundational course covering the basics of ethical hacking, network security, and penetration testing. |
| 2 | COU2279 | Cybersecurity Attack and Defense Fundamentals Specialization | Coursera | Builds on the previous course, focusing on attack and defense strategies, digital forensics, and network defense. |
| 3 | COU4667 | Introduction to Cybersecurity Foundations | Coursera | Introduces the learner to the fundamentals of cybersecurity, including networking, cloud computing, and security principles. |
| 4 | COU1462 | Ethical Hacking Fundamentals | Coursera | Expands on the previous course, covering intermediate-level topics in penetration testing, footprinting, and cyber security assessment. |
| 5 | COU5344 | Cybersecurity Fundamentals Specialization | Coursera | Focuses on the fundamentals of computer security incident management, security domains, and career development in cybersecurity. |
| 6 | COU6211 | Cybersecurity and Its Ten Domains | Coursera | Introduces the learner to the ten domains of cybersecurity, including cryptography, information security, and cyber-security regulation. |
| 7 | COU2156 | IT Fundamentals for Cybersecurity Specialization | Coursera | Covers the basics of networking, database vulnerabilities, operating system security, and cyber attacks. |
| 8 | COU5555 | Foundations of Cybersecurity | Coursera | Expands on the previous course, covering the NIST cybersecurity framework, historical attacks, and ethics in cybersecurity. |
| 9 | COU3811 | Penetration Testing, Threat Hunting, and Cryptography | Coursera | Focuses on advanced topics in penetration testing, threat hunting, and cryptography, building on the previous courses. |
| 10 | COU1726 | Introduction to Cybersecurity Essentials | Coursera | Introduces the learner to the essentials of cybersecurity, including cryptography, cyberattacks, and information security. |

This learning path covers the full duration of 10 periods, with at least one course per period. The path starts with foundational courses in ethical hacking and cybersecurity fundamentals, then progresses to intermediate-level topics in penetration testing, threat hunting, and cryptography. The final course introduces the learner to advanced topics in penetration testing, threat hunting, and cryptography. The path is designed to build on prior knowledge and skills, with each new course introducing new ideas and concepts gradually to avoid overwhelming the learner. The path also incorporates hands-on activities, simulations, and real-world scenarios to make the learning experience engaging and relevant.

**Learning Path**

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | COU1795 | Data Engineering Foundations Specialization | Coursera | Foundational course to learn data engineering concepts, including ETL, Python programming, and relational database management system (RDBMS) |
| 2 | COU5092 | Introduction to Data Engineering | Coursera | Builds on the foundational course, introducing data engineering concepts and tools, including database (DBMS) and SQL |
| 3 | COU3513 | Engineering Data Ecosystems: Pipelines, ETL, Spark | Coursera | Focuses on data pipelines, ETL, and Spark, building on the previous courses and introducing hands-on experience with tools and technologies |
| 4 | COU3684 | DeepLearning.AI Data Engineering Professional Certificate | Coursera | Advances to an intermediate level, covering data management, dataops, data warehousing, and data modeling, with a focus on practical application and problem-solving |
| 5 | COU4211 | Data Engineering: Pipelines, ETL, Hadoop | Coursera | Focuses on data engineering with Hadoop, building on the previous courses and introducing hands-on experience with big data and data pipelines |
| 6 | COU870 | Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate | Coursera | Advances to an advanced level, covering data analysis, data visualization, and data cleansing, with a focus on practical application and problem-solving |
| 7 | COU5486 | Data Engineering Capstone Project | Coursera | Final course, where the learner applies all the skills and knowledge gained throughout the learning path to a real-world data engineering project |

**Learning Path Explanation**

This learning path starts with a foundational course in data engineering, introducing the learner to the concepts and tools of the field. The next course builds on this foundation, introducing data engineering concepts and tools, including database (DBMS) and SQL. The third course focuses on data pipelines, ETL, and Spark, building on the previous courses and introducing hands-on experience with tools and technologies. The fourth course advances to an intermediate level, covering data management, dataops, data warehousing, and data modeling, with a focus on practical application and problem-solving. The fifth course focuses on data engineering with Hadoop, building on the previous courses and introducing hands-on experience with big data and data pipelines. The sixth course advances to an advanced level, covering data analysis, data visualization, and data cleansing, with a focus on practical application and problem-solving. The final course is a capstone project, where the learner applies all the skills and knowledge gained throughout the learning path to a real-world data engineering project.

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | COU3203 | Preparation for CompTIA A+ Certification Specialization | Coursera | This course provides a solid foundation in computer science and technology, covering topics such as network security, hardware troubleshooting, and operating systems. |
| 2 | COU5372 | C for Everyone: Structured Programming | Coursera | Building on the foundational concepts learned in the previous course, this course introduces structured programming and algorithm design, essential skills for any computer science learner. |
| 3 | COU6047 | Discrete Mathematics | Coursera | This course delves into the world of discrete mathematics, covering topics such as combinatorics, graph theory, and algorithms, providing a deeper understanding of mathematical concepts. |
| 4 | COU4176 | Data Structures and Algorithms Specialization | Coursera | With a solid grasp of discrete mathematics, this course focuses on data structures and algorithms, teaching learners how to design and analyze efficient algorithms and data structures. |
| 5 | COU4282 | Practice Exam for ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity (CC) | Coursera | This course provides a comprehensive review of cybersecurity concepts, preparing learners for the ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity (CC) exam and reinforcing their understanding of computer security incident management, network security, and access control. |
| 6 | COU3541 | Fundamentals of Computing Specialization | Coursera | This course covers the fundamental concepts of computing, including recursion, algorithms, and dynamic programming, providing a solid foundation for advanced computer science topics. |
| 7 | COU6362 | C# for .NET Developers | Coursera | Building on the fundamentals of computing, this course introduces the C# programming language and .NET framework, essential skills for any computer science learner. |
| 8 | COU5407 | Introduction to Information Systems for Business Specialization | Coursera | This course provides a comprehensive overview of information systems, covering topics such as cloud technology, cybersecurity, and data management, preparing learners for a career in business and technology. |
| 9 | COU5105 | Salesforce Fundamentals Specialization | Coursera | With a solid understanding of information systems, this course introduces the Salesforce platform, teaching learners how to design and implement effective business solutions. |
| 10 | COU6393 | Vital Skills for Data Science Specialization | Coursera | This course covers the essential skills for data science, including information privacy, cybersecurity, and analysis, preparing learners for a career in data science and analytics. |

The learning path is designed to progress from foundational to advanced, covering the full duration the learner asked for. Each course builds on the previous one, introducing new concepts and reinforcing existing ones. The path covers a range of topics, from computer science and technology to data science and analytics, providing a comprehensive education in computer science.

**How the path fits together**

This learning path is designed to help learners become confident public speakers and presenters. It starts with foundational courses in public speaking and presentation, such as Dynamic Public Speaking Specialization and Introduction to Public Speaking. As learners progress, they develop skills in effective communication, presentation structure, and English speaking. The path also includes courses that focus on specific skills, such as presenting complex ideas and data, and developing soft skills and professional skills for effective communication. The final courses in the path reinforce and solidify the learners' skills in public speaking and presentation.

**Learning Path for Molecular Biology and Genetics**
=====================================================

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | COU4673 | Biology Everywhere Foundations | Coursera | Foundational knowledge in biology and chemistry |
| 2 | COU2930 | The Little Stuff: Energy, Cells, and Genetics | Coursera | Introduction to molecular biology and genetics |
| 3 | COU2547 | Introduction to Genomic Technologies | Coursera | Understanding of genomics and bioinformatics |
| 4 | COU1577 | Fundamental Skills in Bioinformatics | Coursera | Bioinformatics skills and Python programming |
| 5 | COU4054 | Bioinformatics Specialization | Coursera | In-depth bioinformatics and algorithms |
| 6 | COU2866 | DNA Decoded | Coursera | Intermediate-level genetics and genomics |
| 7 | COU830 | Systems Biology and Biotechnology Specialization | Coursera | Systems biology and biotechnology applications |
| 8 | COU5783 | Genomic Data Science Specialization | Coursera | Advanced genomics and data science |
| 9 | COU3178 | Engineering Genetic Circuits: Design | Coursera | Genetic circuit design and engineering |
| 10 | COU1896 | Finding Hidden Messages in DNA (Bioinformatics I) | Coursera | Bioinformatics and machine learning applications |

The learning path starts with foundational knowledge in biology and chemistry (COU4673), followed by an introduction to molecular biology and genetics (COU2930). The next step is to understand genomics and bioinformatics (COU2547), which is then built upon with bioinformatics skills and Python programming (COU1577). The path continues with in-depth bioinformatics and algorithms (COU4054), followed by intermediate-level genetics and genomics (COU2866). The learner then applies systems biology and biotechnology concepts (COU830) and advanced genomics and data science (COU5783). The final two courses focus on genetic circuit design and engineering (COU3178) and bioinformatics and machine learning applications (COU1896). This learning path provides a comprehensive understanding of molecular biology and genetics, from foundational knowledge to advanced applications.

**Learning Path Recommendation**

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | COU3731 | Online Learning Design for Educators Specialization | Coursera | This course provides a foundational understanding of online learning design, which is essential for building online courses. |
| 2 | EDX2165 | Designing and Developing an Online Course | edX | This course builds on the foundational concepts learned in the first course, providing a more in-depth understanding of instructional design and online course development. |
| 3 | COU1859 | How to Create an Online Course | Coursera | This course focuses on practical application, providing hands-on experience in creating an online course. |
| 4 | EDX425 | Instructional Design Models | edX | This course explores different instructional design models, which is essential for creating effective online courses. |
| 5 | COU54 | Instructional Design Foundations and Applications | Coursera | This course provides a comprehensive understanding of instructional design, including analysis, design, development, implementation, and evaluation. |
| 6 | EDX2784 | Design, Build, & Implement | edX | This course focuses on the practical application of instructional design, providing hands-on experience in designing and building online courses. |
| 7 | COU6018 | Virtual Teacher Final Project | Coursera | This course provides a capstone experience, allowing learners to apply their knowledge and skills in a real-world project. |

**Why this path?**

This learning path provides a comprehensive understanding of instructional design and online course development, starting with foundational concepts and gradually increasing in complexity. The path is designed to build on existing skills and knowledge, rather than requiring a complete restart. The courses are chosen to provide regular feedback and opportunities for learners to reflect on their progress, as well as connect the new skills to real-world scenarios and applications. The path is flexible and adaptable to the learner's needs, allowing them to work at their own pace and revisit topics as needed.

| 3 | EDX2112 | Programming Pedagogy in Primary Schools: Developing Computing Teaching | edx | Introduces programming concepts and pedagogies, preparing learners for more advanced topics |
| 4 | EDX1225 | Teaching Programming to 5- to 11-year-olds | edx | Focuses on teaching programming to primary school children, building on the programming concepts introduced in the previous course |
| 5 | EDX1017 | An Introduction to Pre-University Mathematics | edx | Introduces pre-university mathematics concepts, preparing learners for more advanced math topics |
